newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India to issue Jan kero tender soon, closing Dec 5.
newsitem.headline: India to issue Jan kero tender soon, closing Dec 5.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) will issue a tender either later on Monday or on Tuesday to buy superior kerosene oil for January delivery, trading sources said on Monday.
The tender will seek the normal monthly volumes of kerosene - 30,000 tonnes to the west coast and 45,000 tonnes to the east coast.
The tender is likely to close on December 5 and offers will be valid until December 6.
In its last tender for December delivery, IOC purchased 75,000 tonnes of kerosene in two cargoes.
